question: Find the name and location of the stadiums which some concerts happened in the years of both 2014 and 2015.
classification_result:
Reason: Need to join stadium with concert on Stadium_ID, then group by stadium and check that it has concerts in both 2014 and 2015. No nested queries are required.
Label: NON-NESTED
Sub_questions: []
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT stadium.Name, stadium.Location
FROM stadium
JOIN concert AS c1 ON stadium.Stadium_ID = c1.Stadium_ID
JOIN concert AS c2 ON stadium.Stadium_ID = c2.Stadium_ID
WHERE c1.Year = 2014 AND c2.Year = 2015;
